meta_data.base_class: Retrieve the current names of <political leadership positions> for specified countries — these positions are all queried with countries as the indexing parameter.
derived_classes: chief justices of the Supreme Court

tool_template.name: Get<class>Names
tool_template.description: Retrieves the current <class> names for a list of specified countries.

countries.description: An array of country names for which to retrieve the current <class> names. Each country name should be in the format of its common English full name.

start_date.description: The start date from which to retrieve the current <class> names, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: The end date up to which to retrieve the current <class> names, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

include_interim.description: Indicates whether to include interim or acting <class> in the results.

sort_order.description: Specifies the order in which to return the <class> names, being 'by start date', 'by country' or 'by tenure'

output_format.description: The format in which to return the results. Options are 'json', 'csv'.
